A prayer which increases [[Faith]] and donations by 50%/100%/150%. It can be crafted at the [[Desk]] or [[Desk II]]. The quality is dependent on the ingredients and for the sermon to be successful it needs  15{{Church Rating}}/30{{Church Rating}}/60{{Church Rating}}. The Combo prayer is as effective as the [[Prayer for donations]] and better than the [[Prayer for faith]].
